stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Students researched why their street was named Harbor Road, even though the sea was now far away.”?
options: Then the guide showed old photos of trash piles.
Old maps showed that the coastline had once been closer.

本文可直接核對「Old maps showed that the coastline had once been closer.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Old maps show how people once understood the world.'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「An old hand-drawn map showed large trees that once lined a city street.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
